title: Their African Islands Were Set to Be Decolonized. Then the U.S. Bombed Iran.
summary: The inhabitants of the Chagos Islands were expelled by the British 60 years ago. Refugees were anxious to return this year, but their hopes have been caught in a morass of geopolitics.
